data.why: the page ships its own example coordinate list (SAGA Satellites NGC6181/NGC5602 targets) preloaded in the textarea; there is no file upload control, so nothing needs to be copied or written

goals: paste or edit a list of target R.A./Dec. coordinates and visually inspect their DECaLS/SDSS/DSS image cutouts
switch between imaging layers (Legacy Surveys DR10/DR9, SDSS, DES, HSC, DSS, WISE, GALEX) to check how a target looks across surveys
adjust the cutout size (arcmin) to zoom in or out on each target
enable marking mode and click through the cutout grid to flag targets for follow-up or rejection
export the marked selections back out as a table with a 'marked' column for use in downstream target selection

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose correctly: look at survey cutouts for a target list, flag the good ones by clicking, and write a marked column back into the table. Its three phases and ten tasks are at the right depth, and most cited screens match their nodes. Before filing it needs a few accuracy fixes (the header-error claim, 'export', the custom-list evidence that shows duplicate tiles, the tooltip screen) and a few missing tasks: resuming from earlier marks, opening a target in the survey's own viewer, and the ?randrot and ?input= options.
